action.command:
cd /workspace; WEBIP=$(docker inspect -f '{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks "ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default").IPAddress}}' ddev-tfm-fachplanung-web)
runc() { docker run --rm --user 1000:1000 -v /workspace:/e2e -w /e2e --network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default --add-host web:$WEBIP \
  -e CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web -e CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password \
  -e CYPRESS_user_r2=r2_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r2=r2_password \
  cypress/included:13.17.0 run --spec "$1" 2>&1; }
runc "cypress/e2e/01-infrastruktur_setup.cy.js" | grep -E "passing|failing|✖|✔" | tail -5
echo "===== now 02 ====="
runc "cypress/e2e/02-benutzerverwaltung.cy.js" | grep -E "passing|failing|Tests:|Passing:|Failing:|✖|LDAP" | tail -12
